Question B-001-009-007.

Why the correct answer is right: Unqualified family members cannot transmit alone because control operators need suitable amateur qualifications.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "They must not use your equipment without your permission": Permission from the owner is not enough without operator qualification.
- sourceIndex 2: "They must first know how to use the right abbreviations and Q signals": Operating vocabulary does not replace the required qualification.
- sourceIndex 3: "They must first know the right frequencies and emission modes for transmitting": Technical knowledge of settings is not the same as being qualified as a control operator.
